cell_battery_manufacturer.label: Cell & battery manufacturer
cell_battery_manufacturer.definition: Companies that manufacture electrochemical cells, batteries or battery modules.

materials_supplier.label: Materials & chemicals
materials_supplier.definition: Suppliers of active materials, electrolytes, separators, binders, conductive additives or battery-grade chemicals.

automotive_oem.label: Automotive OEM
automotive_oem.definition: Vehicle manufacturers and automotive groups applying battery technology.

electronics_power_systems.label: Electronics & power systems
electronics_power_systems.definition: Electronics, controls, power-conversion, sensing and industrial electrical-system companies.

energy_storage_integrator.label: Energy-storage integrator
energy_storage_integrator.definition: Companies integrating cells into stationary, mobility or industrial energy-storage systems.

charging_grid.label: Charging & grid
charging_grid.definition: Charging, grid-interface, power-network and energy-service companies.

recycling_circularity.label: Recycling & circularity
recycling_circularity.definition: Battery collection, dismantling, recycling, recovery and second-life companies.

research_academic.label: Research & academic
research_academic.definition: Universities, public research organisations, laboratories and technology institutes.

other_industrial.label: Other industrial
other_industrial.definition: Corporate applicants not yet assigned to a more specific battery value-chain category.

unresolved.label: Unresolved entity
unresolved.definition: Applicant names that require entity-curator resolution before a value-chain role can be asserted.
